title_en: Selected Traditions from the Maghāzī of Mūsā ibn ʿUqba
title_ar: أحاديث منتخبة من مغازي موسى بن عقبة

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Maghāzī of Mūsā ibn ʿUqba · p. 59
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَاب أَخْبَرَنِي سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.matn_ar: يَقُولُ بَيْنَا أَنَا نَائِمٌ رَأَيْتُ أَنِّي أَطُوفُ بِالْكَعْبَةِ ، فَإِذَا رَجُلٌ سَبِطُ الشَّعْرِ بَيْنَ الرَّجُلَيْنِ ينظف أَوْ يُهْرَاقُ رَأْسُهُ مَاءً فَقُلْتُ: مَنْ هَذَا؟ قَالُوا: ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ فَذَهَبْتُ أَلْتَفِتُ ، فَإِذَا رَجُلٌ أَحْمَرُ جَسِيمٌ جَعْدُ الرَّأْسِ أَعْوَرُ كَأَنَّ عَيْنَهُ عنبة طافية فقلت من هذا قالوا: الدَّجَّالُ أَقْرَبُ النَّاسِ لَهُ شَبَهًا ابْنُ قَطَنٍ الخزاعي.
entries.isnad_en: He said: Ibn Shihab said: Salim b. 'Abd Allah informed me that 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar ﵄ said: I heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say:
entries.matn_en: While I was asleep, I saw myself circumambulating the Ka'ba, and there was a man with lank hair between two men, his head dripping or pouring water. I said: Who is this? They said: The son of Mary. Then I went to turn, and there was a ruddy, stout man with curly hair, blind in one eye, as though his eye were a floating grape. I said: Who is this? They said: Al-Dajjal. The person who most resembles him is Ibn Qatan al-Khuza'i.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Maghāzī of Mūsā ibn ʿUqba · p. 61
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ: قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَاب وكان أول من جمع الجمع بِالْمَدِينَةِ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ قَبْلَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يعني مصعب بن عمير.
entries.matn_en: He said: Ibn Shihab said: The first to hold the Friday congregational prayer (jumu'a) in Medina for the Muslims before the Messenger of God ﷺ was — meaning — Mus'ab b. 'Umayr.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Maghāzī of Mūsā ibn ʿUqba · p. 64
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنا ابْنُ شِهَاب حَديثا مِنْ حَدِيثِ سُرَاقَةَ يُخَالِفُ هَذَا قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَالِكِ بْنِ جُعْشَمٍ الْمُدْلِجِيُّ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ أَبَاهُ مَالِكًا أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ أَخَاهُ سُرَاقَةَ بْنَ جُعْشَمٍ أَخْبَرَهُ؛ أَنَّهُ لَمَّا خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ مَكَّةَ مُهَاجِرًا إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ جَعَلَتْ قريش لمن رده عليهم مئة نَاقَةٍ ، قَالَ: فَبَيْنَا أَنَا جَالِسٌ فِي نَادِي قومي إذ جاء رجل منا قال: وَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ ثَلاثَةً مَرُّوا عليَّ آنِفًا إني لأظنه محمدا فَأَوْمَأْتُ لَهُ بِعَيْنِي أَنِ اسْكُتْ، فَقُلْتُ: إِنَّمَا هُمْ بَنُو فُلانٍ يَبْغُونَ ضَالَّةً لَهُمْ، قَالَ: لعله، ثم سكت، قال: فمكثت قَلِيلا ثُمَّ قُمْتُ فَدَخَلْتُ بَيْتِي فَأَمَرْتُ بِفَرَسِي فَقِيدَ إِلَى بَطْنِ الْوَادِي. قَالَ: فَأَخْرَجْتُ سِلاحِي ⦗ص: 65⦘ مِنْ وَرَاءِ حُجْرَتِي، ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُ قِدَاحِي الَّتِي أَسْتَقْسِمُ بِهَا، ثُمَّ لَبِسْتُ لأْمَتِي، ثُمَّ أَخْرَجْتُ قِدَاحِي فَاسْتَقْسَمْتُ بِهَا، فَخَرَجَ السَّهْمُ الَّذِي أَكْرَهُ: لأنصره، قال: وكنت أرجو أن أرده فآخذ المئة الناقة، قَالَ: فَرَكِبْتُ عَلَى أَثَرِهِ فَبَيْنَا فَرَسِي يَشْتَدُّ بِي عَثَرَ فَسَقَطْتُ عَنْهُ، قَالَ: فَأَخْرَجْتُ قِدَاحِي فَاسْتَقْسَمْتُ بِهَا فَخَرَجَ السَّهْمُ الَّذِي أَكْرَهُ: لا تضره، فَأَبَيْتُ إِلا أَنْ أَتْبَعَهُ، فَرَكِبْتُ فَلَمَّا بَدَا لِي الْقَوْمُ فَنَظَرْتُ إِلَيْهِمْ عَثَرَ فَرَسِي، فَذَهَبَتْ يَدَاهُ فِي الأَرْضِ، فَسَقَطْتُ عَنْهُ، فاستُخرج، وَأُتْبِعُهُ دخان مثل العثان، فَعَرَفْتُ أَنَّهُ مُنِعَ مِنِّي وَأَنَّهُ ظَاهِرٌ، فَنَادَيْتُهُمْ فقلت: انظروني فو الله لا أُرِيبُكُمْ، وَلا يَأْتِيكُمْ منِيِّ شَيْءٌ تَكْرَهُونَهُ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: قل له ماذا تبتغي؟ قال: قلت اكتب كِتَابًا يَكُونُ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكَ آيَةً؟ قَالَ: اكْتُبْ له يا أبا بكر، قال: فَكَتَبَ ثُمَّ أَلْقَاهُ إِلَيَّ. فَسَكَتُّ فَلَمْ أَذْكُرْ شَيْئًا مِمَّا كَانَ، حَتَّى إِذَا فَتَحَ اللَّهُ مَكَّةَ وَفَرَغَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ أَهْلِ حُنَيْنٍ؛ خَرَجْتُ ⦗ص: 66⦘ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لأَنْ أَلْقَاهُ ومعي الكتاب الذي كتب لي، فبينا أَنَا عَامِدٌ لَهُ؛ دَخَلْتُ بَيْنَ ظَهْرَيْ كَتِيبَةٍ مِنْ كَتَائِبِ الأَنْصَارِ، قَالَ: فَطَفِقُوا يَقْرَعُونِي بِالرِّمَاحِ، ويقولون: إليك إليك، حتى دنوت إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وهو على ناقته، أَنْظُرُ إِلَى سَاقِهِ فِي غَرْزَهِ كَأَنَّهَا جُمَّارَةٌ فَرَفَعْتُ يَدِي بِالْكِتَابِ فَقُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، هَذَا كِتَابُكَ، فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: يَوْمُ وَفَاءٍ وَبِرٍّ، ادْنُهْ، قَالَ: فَأَسْلَمْتُ ثُمَّ ذَكَرْتُ شَيْئًا أَسْأَلُ عَنْهُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم. قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ: إِنَّمَا سأله عَنِ الضَّالَّةِ وَشَيْءٍ فَعَلَهُ فِي وَجْهِهِ. فَمَا ذَكَرْتُ شَيْئًا إِلا أَنِّي قَدْ قُلْتُ: يَا رسول الله، الضَّالَّةُ تَغْشَى حِيَاضِي قَدْ مَلأْتُهَا لإِبِلِي هَلْ لِي مِنْ أَجْرٍ أُسِقيهَا؟ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: نعم في كل كبد حر أجر، فَانْصَرَفْتُ فَسُقْتُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَدَقَتِي.
entries.matn_en: a report from the reports of Suraqa that differs from this. He said: 'Abd al-Rahman b. Malik b. Ju'shum al-Mudliji narrated to me that his father Malik informed him that his brother Suraqa b. Ju'shum informed him that when the Messenger of God ﷺ left Mecca as an emigrant to Medina, Quraysh set a hundred she-camels as the prize for whoever returned him to them. He said: While I was sitting in a gathering (nadi) of my people, a man of ours came and said: By God, I have just seen three [riders] pass by me; I think it is Muhammad. I signaled to him with my eye to be quiet, and said: They are only the sons of so-and-so looking for a stray animal of theirs. He said: Perhaps. Then he fell silent. He said: I waited a little, then got up and entered my house, ordered my mare, and she was led to the bottom of the valley. He said: I brought out my weapons ⦗p. 65⦘ from behind my room, then took my divining arrows with which I cast lots (istaqsimu), then put on my armor, then drew out my arrows and cast lots with them, and the arrow I disliked came out: “I shall surely support him.” He said: And I was hoping to return him and take the hundred she-camels. He said: So I rode on his trail, and while my mare was galloping with me she stumbled and I fell off her. He said: I drew out my arrows and cast lots with them, and the arrow I disliked came out: “Do not harm him.” But I refused except to follow him, so I rode; and when the party came into view and I looked at them, my mare stumbled, her forelegs sank into the ground and I fell off her; then she was pulled out, and a smoke like 'ithan smoke followed her. So I knew that he was protected from me and that he would prevail. I called out to them, saying: Wait for me; by God, I will not cause you any alarm, and nothing you dislike will come to you from me. The Messenger of God ﷺ said: Ask him what he wants. He said: I said: Write a document for me that will be a sign between me and you. He said: Write it for him, Abu Bakr. He said: So he wrote it, then threw it to me. I kept silent and mentioned nothing of what had happened, until God opened Mecca and the Messenger of God ﷺ had finished with the people of Hunayn; I went out ⦗p. 66⦘ to the Messenger of God ﷺ to meet him, with the document he had written for me. While I was making for him, I entered between the backs of one of the squadrons of the Ansar; they began to prod me with spears, saying: Back, back! until I drew near the Messenger of God ﷺ, who was on his she-camel, and I looked at his leg in the stirrup, as though it were the pith of a palm. I raised my hand with the document and said: O Messenger of God, this is your document. The Messenger of God ﷺ said: Today is a day of fidelity and righteousness; come near. He said: So I became a Muslim; then I remembered something I wished to ask the Messenger of God ﷺ about. Ibn Shihab said: He only asked him about the stray animal and something he had done on his journey. I did not mention anything except that I said: O Messenger of God, strays come to my troughs, which I have filled for my camels; is there any reward for me if I give them water? The Messenger of God ﷺ said: Yes; in every living creature (lit. warm liver) there is a reward. So I departed and drove my alms (sadaqa) to the Messenger of God ﷺ.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Maghāzī of Mūsā ibn ʿUqba · p. 68
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ وَزَعَمَ ابْنُ شِهَاب أَنَّ عُرْوَةَ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ قَالَ إِنَّ الزُّبَيْرَ لَقِيَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم في ركب مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ كَانُوا تُجَّارًا بِالشَّامِ قَافِلِينَ إِلَى مكة فعارضوا رسول اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَكَسَى الزُّبَيْرُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَبَا بكر ثيابا بيضا.
entries.matn_en: He said: Ibn Shihab claimed that 'Urwa b. al-Zubayr said that al-Zubayr met the Messenger of God ﷺ among a party of Muslims who had been merchants in Syria and were returning to Mecca; they encountered the Messenger of God ﷺ, and al-Zubayr clothed the Messenger of God ﷺ and Abu Bakr in white garments.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Maghāzī of Mūsā ibn ʿUqba · p. 69
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ: قَالَ نَافِعٌ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ قَالَ أُنَاسٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أتنادي أناسا موتى فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا أَنْتُمْ بِأَسْمَعَ لِمَا قُلْتُ مِنْهُمْ.
entries.matn_en: He said: Nafi' said: 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar said: Some of the Companions of the Messenger of God ﷺ said: Are you calling to people who are dead? The Messenger of God ﷺ said: You do not hear what I say any better than they do.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Maghāzī of Mūsā ibn ʿUqba · p. 70
entries.isnad_ar: قال: قال ابن شِهَاب حَدَّثَنا أنس بن مالك
entries.matn_ar: إِنَّ رِجَالا مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ اسْتَأْذَنُوا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فقالوا ائذن لنا يا رسول الله فلنترك لابن أختنا عباس فداه فقال لا والله ولا تذروا درهما.
entries.isnad_en: He said: Ibn Shihab said: Anas b. Malik narrated to us
entries.matn_en: that some men of the Ansar asked permission of the Messenger of God ﷺ, saying: Permit us, O Messenger of God, to forgo for our nephew 'Abbas his ransom. He said: No, by God; do not leave a single dirham.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Maghāzī of Mūsā ibn ʿUqba · p. 71
entries.matn_ar: وَكَانَ ابْنُ شِهَاب يَقُولُ فِي هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ السُّلَمِيُّ وَرِجَالٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ أَنَّ عَامِرَ بْنَ مالك بن جعفر الذي يدعى لاعب الأَسِنَّةِ قَدِمَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ مُشْرِكٌ فَعَرَضَ عَلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الإِسْلامَ فَأَبَى أن يسلم وأهدى لرسول اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم هَدِيَّةً. فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: إِنِّي لا أَقْبَلُ هَدِيَّةَ مُشْرِكٍ فَقَالَ عَامِرُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ابْعَثْ مَعِي مَنْ شِئْتَ مِنْ رُسُلِكَ فَأَنَا لَهُمْ جَارٍ. ⦗ص: 72⦘ فَبَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَهْطًا فيهم الْمُنْذِرُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو السَّاعِدِيُّ وَهُوَ الَّذِي يُقَالُ له أَعنِقْ لتموت عَيناً لَهُ فِي أَهْلِ نَجْدٍ فَسَمِعَ بِهِمْ عَامِرُ بْنُ الطُّفَيْلِ فَاسْتَنْفَرَ بَنِي عَامِرٍ فَأَبَوْا أَنْ يُطِيعُوهُ وَأَبَوْا أَنْ يَخْفِرُوا عَامِرَ بْنَ مالك فاستنفر لهم مالك بْنُ الطُّفَيْلِ بَنِي سُلَيْمٍ فَنَفَرُوا مَعَهُ فَقَتَلُوهُمْ بِبِئْرِ مَعُونَةَ غَيْرَ عَمْرِو بْنِ أُمَيَّةَ الضَّمْرِيِّ أَخَذَهُ عَامِرُ بْنُ الطُّفَيْلِ فَأَرْسَلَهُ، فَلَمَّا قَدِمَ عَمْرُو بْنُ أُمَيَّةَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أمن بينهم.
entries.matn_en: Ibn Shihab used to say in this hadith: 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Abd Allah b. Ka'b b. Malik al-Sulami and men of the people of knowledge narrated to me that 'Amir b. Malik b. Ja'far, who is called Mula'ib al-Asinna (“Player with Spears”), came to the Messenger of God ﷺ while he was a polytheist; the Messenger of God ﷺ offered him Islam, but he refused to become a Muslim, and he gave the Messenger of God ﷺ a gift. The Messenger of God ﷺ said: I do not accept the gift of a polytheist. 'Amir b. Malik said: O Messenger of God, send with me whomever you wish of your messengers, and I will be their protector (jar). ⦗p. 72⦘ So the Messenger of God ﷺ sent a party (raht), among them al-Mundhir b. 'Amr al-Sa'idi, who is the one of whom it is said: “A'niq li-tamuta” (“Hasten, that you may die”), a scout ('ayn) of his among the people of Najd. 'Amir b. al-Tufayl heard of them and called the Banu 'Amir to arms, but they refused to obey him and refused to violate the protection of 'Amir b. Malik; so Malik b. al-Tufayl called the Banu Sulaym to arms for them, and they set out with him and killed them at Bi'r Ma'una, except for 'Amr b. Umayya al-Damri, whom 'Amir b. al-Tufayl took and released. When 'Amr b. Umayya came to the Messenger of God ﷺ, the Messenger of God ﷺ said to him: [You are] safe from among them.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Maghāzī of Mūsā ibn ʿUqba · p. 75
entries.isnad_ar: حدثنا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بن عمر فطعن بَعْضُ النَّاسِ فِي إِمَارَةِ أُسَامَةَ فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ إِنْ تَطْعُنُوا فِي إِمَارَةِ أُسَامَةَ فَقَدْ كُنْتُمْ تَطْعُنُونَ في إمارة أبيه من قبل وَأَيْمُ اللَّهِ إِنْ كَانَ لَخَلِيقًا لإِمَارَةٍ وَإِنْ كَانَ لَمِنْ أَحَبِّ النَّاسِ كُلِّهِمْ إِلَيَّ وَإِنَّ هَذَا لَمِنْ أَحَبِّ النَّاسِ إِلَيَّ بَعْدَهُ فَاسْتَوْصُوا بِهِ خَيْرًا مِنْ بَعْدِي فَإِنَّهُ مِنْ خِيَارِكُمْ.
entries.isnad_en: Isma'il b. Ibrahim b. 'Uqba narrated to us, saying:
entries.matn_en: Salim b. 'Abd Allah said: 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar said: Some people criticized the appointment of Usama as commander, so the Messenger of God ﷺ stood and said: If you criticize the appointment of Usama as commander, you used to criticize the appointment of his father before him; and by God, he was fit for command, and he was among the most beloved of all people to me, and this one is among the most beloved of people to me after him; so treat him well after me, for he is among the best of you.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Maghāzī of Mūsā ibn ʿUqba · p. 77
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ مُوسَى: قَالَ سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ مَا كَانَ رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يَسْتَثْنِي فَاطِمَةَ رضي الله عنها.
entries.matn_en: Musa said: Salim b. 'Abd Allah said: 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar said: The Messenger of God ﷺ did not make an exception of Fatima ﵂.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Maghāzī of Mūsā ibn ʿUqba · p. 78
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ قَالَ مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ رضي الله عنه يَقُولُ حَزِنْتُ عَلَى من أصيب بالحرة من قومي فكتب إِلَى زَيْدِ بْنِ أَرْقَمَ وَبَلَغَهُ شِدَّةُ حُزْنِي يذكر أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِلأَنْصَارِ وَلأَبْنَاءِ الأَنْصَارِ وشك الفضل في أبناء أبناء الأنصار.
entries.isnad_en: He said: Musa b. 'Uqba said: 'Abd Allah b. al-Fadl narrated to me that he heard Anas b. Malik ﵁ say:
entries.matn_en: I grieved for those of my people who were struck down at al-Harra; so Zayd b. Arqam wrote to me — it having reached him how intense my grief was — mentioning that he had heard the Messenger of God ﷺ say: O God, forgive the Ansar and the sons of the Ansar; and al-Fadl was uncertain about “the sons of the sons of the Ansar.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Maghāzī of Mūsā ibn ʿUqba · p. 78
entries.matn_ar: قال ابْنُ الْفَضْلِ فَسَأَلَ نَاسٌ بَعْضَ مَنْ كَانَ عِنْدَهُ ⦗ص: 79⦘ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَرْقَمَ فَقَالَ هُوَ الذي يقول لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم هَذَا الَّذِي أَوْفَى اللَّهُ لَهُ بِإِذْنِهِ.
entries.matn_en: Ibn al-Fadl said: Some people asked some of those who were with him ⦗p. 79⦘ about Zayd b. Arqam, and he said: He is the one of whom the Messenger of God ﷺ said: This is the one for whom God has made good, by his permission (bi-idhnihi).

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Maghāzī of Mūsā ibn ʿUqba · p. 80
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ: حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ شِهَاب حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيِّبِ وَابْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لِبِلالٍ يَوْمَئِذٍ قُمْ فَأَذِّنْ إِنَّهُ لا يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ إِلا مُؤْمِنٌ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَيُؤَيِّدُ الدِّينَ بِالرَّجُلِ الْفَاجِرِ وَذَلِكَ عِنْدَ ذِكْرِ الرَّجُلِ الَّذِي قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه من أهل النار.
entries.isnad_en: Musa b. 'Uqba said: Ibn Shihab narrated to me: Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab and Ibn 'Abd Allah b. Ka'b b. Malik narrated to me that the Messenger of God ﷺ said to Bilal on that day: Arise and call the adhan, for none enters Paradise but a believer, and God will support this religion by means of an immoral man; and that
entries.matn_en: was at the mention of the man of whom the Messenger of God ﷺ said that he was of the people of the Fire.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Maghāzī of Mūsā ibn ʿUqba · p. 82
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: قَالَ مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ حَدَّثَنا نَافِعٌ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ رضي الله عنهما قَالَ لَمَّا فُتِحَتْ خَيْبَرُ سَأَلَتِ يهود رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يقرهم فيها على أن يعملوا عن نصف ما خرج منها من الثمرة فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نُقِرُّكُمْ فِيهَا عَلَى ذَلِكَ مَا شِئْنَا. فَكَانُوا فِيهَا كَذَلِكَ حَتَّى أَخْرَجَهُمْ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ، يَقُولُ لَمْ يُوصِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إلا بثلاث أوصى للرهاويين من خيبر بجاد مئة وسق وللداريين بجاد مئة وسق وللسبائيين بجاد مئة وسق، وللأشعريين بجاد مئة وَسْقٍ، وَأَوْصَى بِتَنْفِيذِ بَعْثِ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ وأن لا يترك دينان مختلفان.
entries.isnad_en: He said: Musa b. 'Uqba said: Nafi' narrated to us that 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar ﵄ said:
entries.matn_en: When Khaybar was conquered, the Jews asked the Messenger of God ﷺ to let them remain in it on condition that they work for half of the fruit that came out of it; the Messenger of God ﷺ said: We shall let you remain in it on that basis for as long as we wish. So they remained in it in that way until 'Umar b. al-Khattab expelled them. He says: The Messenger of God ﷺ made a bequest in only three matters: he bequeathed to the Rahawiyyin of Khaybar bi-jad a hundred wasqs, and to the Dariyyin bi-jad a hundred wasqs, and to the Saba'iyyin bi-jad a hundred wasqs, and to the Ash'ariyyin bi-jad a hundred wasqs; and he bequeathed the carrying out of the expedition of Usama b. Zayd, and that two different religions not be left [together].

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Maghāzī of Mūsā ibn ʿUqba · p. 86
entries.isnad_ar: وَحَدَّثَنا نَافِعٌ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه كَانَ لا يَدَعُ الْيَهُودَ وَالنَّصَارَى وَلا الْمَجُوسَ يَمْكُثُونَ بالمدينة فوق ثلاثة أيام قدر ما يبيعون وَكَانَ يَقُولُ لا يَجْتَمِعُ دِينَانِ وَإِنَّهُ أَجْلَى الْيَهُودَ وَالنَّصَارَى مِنْ جَزِيرَةِ الْعَرَبِ.
entries.isnad_en: And Nafi' narrated to us from 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar that
entries.matn_en: 'Umar b. al-Khattab ﵁ would not allow Jews, Christians, or Magians to remain in Medina for more than three days, the time needed to sell [their goods]; and he used to say: Two religions shall not be combined; and he expelled the Jews and Christians from the Arabian Peninsula (Jazirat al-'Arab).

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Maghāzī of Mūsā ibn ʿUqba · p. 88
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَاب حَدَّثَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ أَنَّ مَرْوَانَ بْنَ الْحَكَمِ وَالْمِسْوَرَ بْنَ مَخْرَمَةَ أَخْبَرَاهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم [قال] حِينَ أَذِنَ لِلنَّاسِ فِي عِتْقِ سَبْيِ هَوَازِنَ إِنِّي لا أَدْرِي مَنْ أَذِنَ لَكُمْ مِمَّنْ لَمْ يَأْذَنْ فَارْجِعُوا حَتَّى يَرْفَعَ إِلَيْنَا عُرَفَاؤُكُمْ أمركم فرجع الناس فحكمهم عُرَفَاؤُهُمْ فَرَجَعُوا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرُوهُ أَنَّ النَّاسَ قَدْ طَيَّبُوا وأذنوا.
entries.isnad_en: He said: Musa b. 'Uqba narrated to me, saying: Ibn Shihab said: 'Urwa b. al-Zubayr narrated to me that Marwan b. al-Hakam and al-Miswar b. Makhrama informed him
entries.matn_en: that the Messenger of God ﷺ [said], when he permitted the people to free the captives of Hawazin: I do not know who among you has given permission and who has not; so go back until your representatives ('urafa') submit your matter to us. So the people returned, and their representatives arbitrated among them; then they returned to the Messenger of God ﷺ and informed him that the people had willingly consented and given permission.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Maghāzī of Mūsā ibn ʿUqba · p. 90
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَاب أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيِّبِ وعروة بن الزبير
entries.matn_ar: أن سبي هوازن الذي رَدَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كانوا ستة آلاف مِنَ الرِّجَالِ وَالنِّسَاءِ وَالصِّبْيَانِ وَأَنَّهُ خَيَّرَ نِسَاءً كن تحت رجال قُرَيْشٍ مِنْهُمْ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَوْفٍ وَصَفْوَانُ بْنُ أُمَيَّةَ كَانَا قَدِ اسْتَسَرَّا الْمَرْأَتَيْنِ اللَّتَيْنِ كانتا عندهما فاختارتا قومهما.
entries.isnad_en: Ibn Shihab said: Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab and 'Urwa b. al-Zubayr informed me
entries.matn_en: that the captives of Hawazin whom the Messenger of God ﷺ returned were six thousand, men, women, and children, and that he gave a choice to women who were married to men of Quraysh, among them 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Awf and Safwan b. Umayya, who had taken as concubines the two women who were with them; and the two women chose their own people.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Maghāzī of Mūsā ibn ʿUqba · p. 91
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ: ثنا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَاب: وَحَجَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَجَّةَ التَّمَامِ سَنَةَ عَشْرٍ فَأَرَى النَّاسَ مَنَاسِكَهُمْ وَخَطَبَ النَّاسَ بِعَرَفَةَ عَلَى نَاقَتِهِ الْجَدْعَاءِ.
entries.isnad_en: He said: Isma'il b. Ibrahim b. 'Uqba narrated to us, on the authority of his paternal uncle Musa b. 'Uqba, who said:
entries.matn_en: Ibn Shihab said: The Messenger of God ﷺ performed the Pilgrimage of Completion (hajjat al-tamam) in the year ten; he showed the people their rites (manasik) and addressed the people at 'Arafa on his she-camel al-Jad'a'.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Maghāzī of Mūsā ibn ʿUqba · p. 92
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَاب حَدَّثَنا عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ أَنَّ الْمِسْوَرَ بْنَ مَخْرَمَةَ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَمْرَو بْنَ عَوْفٍ، وَهُوَ حَلِيفٌ لبني عامر بن لؤي [قال] كان شَهِدَ بَدْرًا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعَثَ أَبَا عُبَيْدَةَ بْنَ الْجَرَّاحِ يَأْتِي بِجِزْيَتِهَا، وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم هُوَ صَالَحَ أَهْلَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ، وَأَمَّرَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْعَلاءَ بْنَ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ، فَقَدِمَ أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ بِمَالٍ مِنَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ، فَسَمِعَتِ الأَنْصَارُ بِقُدُومِهِ، فَوَافَقَتْ صَلاةَ الصُّبْحِ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَعَرَّضُوا، فَتَبَسَّمَ حِينَ رآهم، وقال: ⦗ص: 93⦘ أظنكم قد سَمِعْتُمْ بِقُدُومِ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ وَأَنَّهُ جَاءَ بِشَيْءٍ؟ فَقَالُوا: أَجَلْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ. قَالَ: فَأَبْشِرُوا وَأْمُلُوا مَا يَسُرُّكُمْ، فَوَاللَّهِ مَا الْفَقْرَ أَخْشَى عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَكِنِّي أَخْشَى عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ تُبْسَطَ عَلَيْكُمُ، كَمَا بُسِطَتْ عَلَى مَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ، فَتَنَافَسُوهَا، وَتُلْهِيكُمْ كَمَا أَلْهَتْهُمْ.
entries.isnad_en: Musa b. 'Uqba narrated to us, saying: Ibn Shihab said: 'Urwa b. al-Zubayr narrated to us that al-Miswar b. Makhrama informed him that 'Amr b. 'Awf, who was an ally of the Banu 'Amir b. Lu'ayy [he said] and had been present at Badr with the Messenger of God ﷺ, informed him
entries.matn_en: that the Messenger of God ﷺ sent Abu 'Ubayda b. al-Jarrah to bring its jizya, the Messenger of God ﷺ himself having made a treaty with the people of Bahrain and appointed al-'Ala' b. al-Hadrami over them. Abu 'Ubayda came with money from Bahrain; the Ansar heard of his arrival, and it coincided with the dawn prayer with the Messenger of God ﷺ; when the Messenger of God ﷺ finished, they presented themselves to him; he smiled when he saw them, and said: ⦗p. 93⦘ I think you have heard of the arrival of Abu 'Ubayda and that he has brought something? They said: Yes, O Messenger of God. He said: Rejoice, and hope for what pleases you; for by God, it is not poverty that I fear for you, but I fear for you that it will be spread out upon you as it was spread out upon those who were before you, and you will vie for it, and it will distract you as it distracted them.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Maghāzī of Mūsā ibn ʿUqba · p. 94
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ سَعْدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ أَنَّ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ عَوْفٍ رضي الله عنه كَانَ مَعَ عُمَرَ بْنِ الخطاب رضي الله عنه يومئذ، وَأَنَّهُ هُوَ كَسَرَ سَيْفَ الزُّبَيْرِ، وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ من كَسْرِهِ ، ثُمَّ قَامَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَخَطَبَ النَّاسَ وَاعْتَذَرَ إِلَيْهِمْ، فَقَالَ: وَاللَّهِ مَا كُنْتُ حَرِيصًا عَلَى الإِمَارَةِ يَوْمًا قَطُّ وَلا لَيْلَةً، وَلا كُنْتُ فِيهَا رَاغِبًا، وَلا سَأَلْتُهَا اللَّهَ قَطُّ فِي سِرٍّ وَلا عَلانِيَةٍ، وَلَكِنِّي أَشْفَقْتُ مِنَ الْفِتْنَةِ، وَمَا لِي فِي الإِمَارَةِ مِنْ رَاحَةٍ، ولكن قلدت أمرا عظيما ما لي به طاقة، ولا يدان إِلا بِتَقْوِيَةِ اللَّهِ عز وجل، وَلَوَدِدْتُ أَنَّ أَقْوَى النَّاسِ عَلَيْهَا مَكَانِي، فَقَبِلَ الْمُهَاجِرُونَ ⦗ص: 95⦘ مِنْهُ مَا قَالَ وَمَا اعْتَذَرَ بِهِ، وَقَالَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ وَالزُّبَيْرُ بْنُ الْعَوَّامِ: مَا غضبنا إلا أنا أخرنا عن المشاورة، وَإِنَّا لَنَرَى أَبَا بَكْرٍ أَحَقَّ النَّاسِ بِهَا بَعْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم، إنه لصاحب الغار، ثاني اثنين، وإنا لنعرف لَهُ شَرَفَهُ وَكِبْرَهُ، وَلَقَدْ أَمَّرَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالصَّلاةِ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُوَ حي.
entries.isnad_en: Musa b. 'Uqba narrated to us, saying: Sa'd b. Ibrahim said: Ibrahim b. 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Awf narrated to me
entries.matn_en: that 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Awf ﵁ was with 'Umar b. al-Khattab ﵁ on that day, and that he was the one who broke al-Zubayr’s sword — and God knows best who broke it — then Abu Bakr stood and addressed the people and made his excuses to them, saying: By God, I was never eager for command (imara) for a day or a night, nor was I desirous of it, nor did I ever ask it of God, in secret or in public; but I feared discord (fitna), and there is no ease for me in command; rather I have been charged with a great matter for which I have neither strength nor ability except through the strengthening of God, Mighty and Majestic; and I would have loved it if the strongest of people for it were in my place. So the Emigrants accepted ⦗p. 95⦘ from him what he said and the excuse he offered; and 'Ali b. Abi Talib and al-Zubayr b. al-'Awwam said: We were angry only because we were put off from the consultation; and we see Abu Bakr as the most deserving of people of it after the Messenger of God ﷺ; he is the Companion of the Cave, the second of the two; we recognize his nobility and seniority; and the Messenger of God ﷺ appointed him to lead the people in prayer while he was alive.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Maghāzī of Mūsā ibn ʿUqba · p. 96
entries.isnad_ar: وَبِالإِسْنَادِ إِلَى أَبِي بَكْرٍ مُحَمَّد بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَتَّابٍ (1) قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّد بْنُ صالح المعروف بكعب الذراع قال: حدثنا شعيب بن إبراهيم حَدَّثَنا سَيْفُ بْنُ عُمَرَ عَنْ أَبِي رَوْقٍ عَطِيَّةَ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ الْهَمْدَانِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عليه السلام
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ نَعَى اللَّهُ عز وجل لِنَبِيِّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَفْسَهُ حِينَ أَنْزَلَ عَلَيْهِ {إِذَا جَاءَ نَصْرُ اللَّهِ والفتح} فكان الفتح من مُهَاجَرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي سَنَةِ ثَمَانٍ فَلَمَّا طُعِنَ فِي سَنَةِ تسع من مُهَاجَرِهِ تَتَابَعَ عَلَيْهِ الْقَبَائِلُ تَسْعَى فَلَمْ يَدْرِ مَتَى الأَجَلُ لَيْلا أَوْ نَهَارًا فَفَعَلَ عَلَى قدر ذلك فوسع السنن وَشَدَّدَ الْفَرَائِضَ وَأَظْهَرَ الرُّخَصَ وَنَسَخَ كَثِيرًا مِنَ الأحاديث فنسخت الرخصة الشك والشك في بعض الرخص وَغَزَا تَبُوكَ وَفَعَلَ فِعْلَ مُوَدِّعٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم.
entries.isnad_en: And by the chain of transmission (isnad) to Abu Bakr Muhammad b. 'Abd Allah b. 'Attab (1), who said: Muhammad b. Salih, known as Ka'b al-Dhira', narrated to us, saying: Shu'ayb b. Ibrahim narrated to us: Sayf b. 'Umar narrated to us, on the authority of Abu Rawq 'Atiyya b. al-Harith al-Hamdani, on the authority of Abu Ayyub, on the authority of 'Ali ﵇, who said:
entries.matn_en: God, Mighty and Majestic, announced to His Prophet ﷺ his own death when He revealed to him {When the help of God and the victory come}; and the conquest was in the eighth year from the emigration of the Messenger of God ﷺ; and when he was stabbed in the ninth year from his emigration, the tribes came to him one after another, hurrying, and he did not know when the appointed term would come, by night or by day; so he acted in accordance with that: he broadened the sunan, made the obligations stricter, made the concessions manifest, and abrogated many of the hadiths; so the concession abrogated doubt, and doubt [abrogated] some of the concessions; and he campaigned at Tabuk and did the deed of one bidding farewell ﷺ.
